scope: 15 references; source inspection and proposed extractions, not newly verified reusable packages

priorities.P0: First extraction wave: bounded contracts and high reuse value
priorities.P1: Second wave: retain fixture and integration dependencies
priorities.P2: Research or blocked: renderer/backend/source recovery coupling

candidates.title: Boat forces and docking
candidates.observed_mechanism: Controls drive spool-up thrust, water-relative forces and forces at the hull; dockForces, boundaryForces and groundForces constrain movement. snapshot/interpolate separate simulation from display.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Inject water velocity, terrain and dock queries into the boat solver; retain units and original coefficients.
candidates.proposed_verification: Replay thrust, reverse, cross-current and dock/undock at fixed timesteps; compare position, heading and applied force traces.

candidates.title: Bridge-aware boat camera
candidates.observed_mechanism: Damped camera modes use floorAt, bridgeCeiling and lineOfSight; angle wrapping and analytic damping avoid abrupt turns.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Camera target plus obstruction-query interface; keep helm and chase modes together until transitions match.
candidates.proposed_verification: Drive under a low bridge, reverse and switch helm/chase; check clipping and continuity at 30/60/120 Hz.

candidates.title: River surface and wake
candidates.observed_mechanism: Water rendering combines clipmap geometry, reflections, a boat mask and a wake grid with sources/weirs.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One short river reach plus original water-query contract and a moving hull; preserve wake/shore inputs.
candidates.proposed_verification: Compare the same bank, boat wake and reflection at original DPR; inspect seams and moving-grid resets.

candidates.title: Delivery, passage and docking progression
candidates.observed_mechanism: Quest data gates cargo/passages/docks/rewards; bridge crossing checks interpolate across movement segments.
candidates.proposed_boundary: A delivery state machine emitting events, with injected storage and location facts.
candidates.proposed_verification: Replay deliveries, cross a gate in one large step, reload mid-route and ensure rewards are not duplicated.

candidates.title: Baked vegetation and impostors
candidates.observed_mechanism: Runtime consumes pre-baked compressed fields/atlases and distant impostors, separate from source GLB vegetation assets.
candidates.proposed_boundary: A small near/far vegetation patch preserving the bake manifest and runtime decoder.
candidates.proposed_verification: Record bytes, decode time, draw counts and silhouettes while crossing LOD thresholds.

candidates.title: Terrain streaming and worker jobs
candidates.observed_mechanism: Quadtree selection/refinement and eviction cooperate with a worker pool and geometry allocator; result buffers include morph positions/normals.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Terrain tile scheduler and geometry job contract around an injected height function.
candidates.proposed_verification: Fly a repeatable path; compare cracks, popping, job queue length and bounded memory after revisiting tiles.

candidates.title: Walk/fly/tour camera handoff
candidates.observed_mechanism: Walk/fly modes query terrain and obstacles; authored tour stops use orbit/push/crane/truck moves and bounded turning/FOV blending.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Input modes plus camera handoff policy; author stops as data instead of copying landmarks.
candidates.proposed_verification: Interrupt every tour move with user input and switch walk/fly; verify no position snaps or stuck pointer lock.

candidates.title: Water fields and worker baking
candidates.observed_mechanism: Water uses wave bands/reflections; the bake worker builds height/SDF-related spatial fields for the surface.
candidates.proposed_boundary: A bounded water region with the exact field-generation and sampling layout.
candidates.proposed_verification: Freeze time and compare shore/depth/reflection samples; measure bake cost separately from steady rendering.

candidates.title: Procedural landmark construction
candidates.observed_mechanism: Separate landmark modules consume common construction helpers; authored structure lives in parameters and geometry code.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One landmark using the original construction vocabulary and material registry.
candidates.proposed_verification: Generate the same seed twice; compare bounding boxes, geometry counts, collisions and silhouette snapshots.

candidates.title: Character locomotion and camera pipeline
candidates.observed_mechanism: Actor, procedural character, camera rig and player input are separate modules but share movement/form/weapon state. Existing lab factories preserve this composition.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Keep locomotion state separate from the rig; expose world queries and input ownership; use existing lab adapters as a migration example.
candidates.proposed_verification: Replay run/jump/form/aim transitions; compare root motion and camera framing. Inspect existing lab QA; do not assume arbitrary GLB compatibility.

candidates.title: GPU painting and CPU surface ownership
candidates.observed_mechanism: Paint appearance and gameplay ownership are separate concerns; the CPU grid supports movement/team queries while the GPU represents marks.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Surface facts plus a rendering adapter; allow a second consumer such as hazard/boost zones.
candidates.proposed_verification: Stamp boundaries, overlapping teams and corners; confirm visual color agrees with queried ownership, including a second gameplay consumer.

candidates.title: Weapon events and audiovisual feedback
candidates.observed_mechanism: Weapons, effect hooks and audio are separated files around gameplay events; existing lab work distinguishes presentation sequences from damage rules.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Typed weapon events feeding effects/audio adapters; keep authoritative hit resolution outside presentation.
candidates.proposed_verification: Use one recorded shot/hit sequence, check damage once and compare impact, sound and paint ordering.

candidates.title: Navigation and bot decision-making
candidates.observed_mechanism: Bots consume navigation and level data rather than only chasing screen coordinates; level construction also defines collision context.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Navigation queries and bot policy against a small original layout.
candidates.proposed_verification: Run seeded rounds; record unreachable objectives, wall collisions, stuck durations and route choice.

candidates.title: Terrain-following robot controller
candidates.observed_mechanism: Production bundle retains ground support/step/drop logic, Rapier bodies and fixed-step accumulation with display interpolation.
candidates.proposed_boundary: A recovered controller around Rapier and support-query inputs; retain the original bundle as the reference.
candidates.proposed_verification: Drive slopes, ledges and steps at different render rates; compare support contacts and interpolated pose.

candidates.title: Vehicle tracks and independent turret
candidates.observed_mechanism: Bundle implements track segments/model data and aim/steering relationships for player and enemy robots.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Track animation driven by travel/turn measurements plus a separately aimed turret.
candidates.proposed_verification: Turn in place, reverse and aim across the hull; compare track phase and turret orientation.

candidates.title: Compressed model/texture loading pipeline
candidates.observed_mechanism: Deployed assets include GLB models and KTX2 textures with a local Basis transcoder.
candidates.proposed_boundary: A loader example retaining decoder versions and compressed-texture support checks.
candidates.proposed_verification: Cold-load offline on target GPU, count missing requests and verify compressed textures visually; keep fallback behavior explicit.

candidates.title: Robot styling and gameplay transitions
candidates.observed_mechanism: The bundle contains material/outline modifications and effect timelines tied to robot gameplay and portfolio transitions.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One robot material/effect sequence with named inputs, separated from portfolio navigation.
candidates.proposed_verification: Freeze matching poses and lighting, compare outlines, effects and transition cleanup after repeated entry/exit.

candidates.title: Local spell language to structured specification
candidates.observed_mechanism: localParse maps bilingual phrases to element/shape/morph/trajectory/payload parameters. Jev parsing is a separate unavailable service path.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Pure parse/normalize/validate specification stage; preserve the local rule parser without calling it AI inference.
candidates.proposed_verification: Table-driven phrases and contradictory/out-of-range inputs; serialize normalized results and compare original casts.

candidates.title: Parameterized spell execution and effects
candidates.observed_mechanism: SpellSystem implements behavior from the normalized specification; VFX helpers represent the same parameters visually.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One projectile plus one self/utility form through the original specification pipeline.
candidates.proposed_verification: Cast the same specification with fixed seed; compare trajectory, contacts, duration and effects at multiple frame rates.

candidates.title: Element reaction and combat rules
candidates.observed_mechanism: reactionFor and applyHit combine aura/element data with Combatant state and enhancements.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Reaction resolution and damage/status events, independent of spell text entry.
candidates.proposed_verification: Cover reaction order, immunity, repeated hits and status expiration; assert exact health/status results.

candidates.title: Worker-painted magic circles
candidates.observed_mechanism: Circle geometry/presentation and paint generation are separated into runtime and worker modules.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One circle renderer with a serializable paint job and bounded result cache.
candidates.proposed_verification: Repeat identical jobs, replace spells rapidly and dispose while a worker finishes; check no stale texture or memory growth.

candidates.title: Procedural world build contract
candidates.observed_mechanism: World modules share construction/context helpers and register static geometry, dynamic objects and update work.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Document and reproduce one block builder using explicit services and deterministic time/randomness.
candidates.proposed_verification: Build twice with the same seed; compare object/collider counts and validate teardown of registered updates.

candidates.title: Material-aware batching and texture atlases
candidates.observed_mechanism: batchStatic bakes material colors into vertex colors, packs eligible canvas textures into atlas pages, and partitions near/far spatial cells. It excludes skinned/instanced/morph/custom cases.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Extract batchStatic with its eligibility checks and material signatures intact.
candidates.proposed_verification: Compare before/after screenshots and draw calls; test transparent materials, repeated UVs and non-batchable objects.

candidates.title: Lightweight walking and colliders
candidates.observed_mechanism: The custom physics layer exposes boxes, ramps/stairs and cylinders for a walkable procedural scene.
candidates.proposed_boundary: A walker with primitive query inputs and stair/ramp fixtures.
candidates.proposed_verification: Walk ramps, stairs, corners and dynamic obstacles; verify grounding and speed independent of render rate.

candidates.title: Scheduled train choreography
candidates.observed_mechanism: Train construction is separate from schedule data/logic, enabling timed world activity in the station scene.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One train and platform driven by a shared clock; retain the original timing relationship.
candidates.proposed_verification: Sample arrival, dwell and departure through a complete original cycle, then jump time and resume.

candidates.title: Layered avatar compositing and caches
candidates.observed_mechanism: Avatar code transforms/flips part canvases and caches results with bounded map eviction; original part assets supply the visual vocabulary.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Avatar composition from explicit part IDs and transforms with bounded cache ownership.
candidates.proposed_verification: Compare multiple outfits, mirrored offsets and cache eviction; verify every part resolves offline.

candidates.title: Room dimensions and furnishing state
candidates.observed_mechanism: Room tiers define cell counts and upgrades; furnishing placement shares world/UI state inside the bundle.
candidates.proposed_boundary: A local room-data editor and placement validator, independent of account purchase operations.
candidates.proposed_verification: Load layouts at each supported room size, validate occupied cells and preserve transforms through save/reload.

candidates.title: Modal UI and world input ownership
candidates.observed_mechanism: Town entry/avatar editing and modal flows coexist with world input; some state changes are gated on asynchronous account operations.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Explicit active-input owner and cancellation policy around editor/gameplay transitions.
candidates.proposed_verification: Hold movement while opening/closing editor/dialogs; verify no stuck keys or movement behind blocking menus.

candidates.title: Account-epoch asynchronous service boundary
candidates.observed_mechanism: Client write queues and epoch checks guard asynchronous account changes, but PHP implementations are absent.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Document the request/state machine as a reference; do not provide fake successful account/chat/payment endpoints.
candidates.proposed_verification: Offline client must report unavailable operations; a future authorized server integration must test account changes during in-flight writes.

candidates.title: Instanced wind volumes
candidates.observed_mechanism: Godot MultiMesh custom attributes encode spawn/lifetime/twist/style; shader deforms tube geometry into multiple wind effects with age-based fade.
candidates.proposed_boundary: A shader algorithm port with explicit instance attribute schema; source shader remains the authority.
candidates.proposed_verification: Freeze age/seed/style and compare silhouettes and fade; test every style before a GLSL/TSL adaptation is called equivalent.

candidates.title: Depth-based toon water
candidates.observed_mechanism: Depth reconstruction controls shallow/deep colors and shoreline foam; Voronoi edges add crest lines and vertex swell perturbs normals.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Water material plus depth-input adapter; handle target engine projection/depth conventions explicitly.
candidates.proposed_verification: Compare shallow/deep/shore samples from a fixed camera; validate depth reconstruction before adjusting style.

candidates.title: Instanced foliage motion and tint
candidates.observed_mechanism: Vertex height controls bending; per-instance RGB and vertex alpha select tinted parts, while an up-biased normal blends vegetation with ground.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One instanced grass/flower patch with authored vertex masks and shared clock.
candidates.proposed_verification: Compare roots/tips, per-instance color and ground transition at fixed time.

candidates.title: Screen transitions and speed feedback
candidates.observed_mechanism: Readable shaders preserve transition and movement feedback even though game scripts are compiled GDC bytecode.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Shader examples first; flight/movement behavior remains a separate decompilation investigation.
candidates.proposed_verification: Sweep transition/speed uniforms and verify aspect-ratio behavior; do not claim original movement source recovery.

candidates.title: Arcade racer forces and track coordinates
candidates.observed_mechanism: stepRacer resolves forward/lateral velocity, drag, speed-dependent yaw, off-road/air modifiers and boost energy; track projection supplies progress and lateral offset.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Track query interface plus one racer state/input step preserving coefficients.
candidates.proposed_verification: Replay throttle/brake/reverse/boost and off-road motion; compare progress and velocity traces at fixed step.

candidates.title: Look-ahead racing AI
candidates.observed_mechanism: aiInput chooses a look-ahead point, changes lanes, avoids racers and estimates corner speed before choosing throttle/brake/boost.
candidates.proposed_boundary: AI produces the same input schema as the player against track/racer queries.
candidates.proposed_verification: Seed lanes, run multiple laps and report wall impacts/stuck time; test narrow sections and overtakes.

candidates.title: Racing chase/cockpit/finish camera
candidates.observed_mechanism: updateCamera blends target heading/height, speed FOV, boost and shake, with distinct menu, cockpit and finish policies.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Camera mode state plus race pose/velocity/event inputs.
candidates.proposed_verification: Compare menu→countdown→race→finish and reverse view; verify no angle-wrap snap and retain original shake.

candidates.title: Procedural track and stable shadow framing
candidates.observed_mechanism: buildTrackMesh uses sampled centerline/lateral geometry; updateSunShadow snaps shadow framing to a texel grid.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One generated track section and its matching collision/query representation.
candidates.proposed_verification: Compare visible road and drivable boundaries; move camera slowly to inspect shadow shimmer without reducing quality.

candidates.title: Shared progression across minigames
candidates.observed_mechanism: Separate shared modules connect items/progress and town return flow across five game entries.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Versioned progression store and return-location messages with game-specific adapters.
candidates.proposed_verification: Earn an item in a minigame, return to town and reload; verify idempotence and shared-state consistency.

candidates.title: Worker-generated procedural characters
candidates.observed_mechanism: Character model construction is split into worker jobs and runtime assembly, including separate kid and NPC pipelines.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One parameterized character job with a versioned transferable result schema.
candidates.proposed_verification: Build identical parameters twice, cancel/restart generation and compare buffer bounds and visible shape.

candidates.title: Procedural fish surface generation
candidates.observed_mechanism: Fish texture generation is available as readable worker code in both common and eel-game pipelines.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One species texture generator with explicit seed/palette/UV contract.
candidates.proposed_verification: Compare seeded surface maps and the rendered fish from several angles; retain species-specific parameters.

candidates.title: Depth-composited water investigation
candidates.observed_mechanism: WaterPass reads color/depth, beach height and murk inputs and reconstructs camera rays. Disabling WaterPass made the scene visible in diagnostic runs; the original site also reproduces black output.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Quarantined reference until the depth/material path is diagnosed; not a ready reusable water module.
candidates.proposed_verification: Reduce to a minimal original pass chain and inspect finite color/depth values. Preserve the effect and original graphics; never use effect removal as the fix.

candidates.title: Fishing tension state machine
candidates.observed_mechanism: CatchMinigame.update integrates tension, line distance, fish stamina and surges with injected RNG; outcomes include caught, snapped and escaped.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Pure fishing simulation plus a tiny input/HUD adapter.
candidates.proposed_verification: Seed fish surges; exercise all terminal outcomes, sustained overload/slack and multiple timesteps.

candidates.title: Inventory, fish records and saves
candidates.observed_mechanism: GameState owns inventory capacity, fish records, money/upgrades/fuel and storage; records can update even when a catch exceeds hold capacity.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Inject storage and events; isolate economy from rendering/boat controls.
candidates.proposed_verification: Catch with full hold, sell, buy, reload malformed/old saves; check balances and non-duplicated records.

candidates.title: FFT ocean with asynchronous surface queries
candidates.observed_mechanism: GPU ocean displacement feeds query compute/readback. WaterQuery records result time, inputs, version and latency because CPU results arrive 1–3 frames later.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Keep ocean surface sampling, latency handling and boat integration as a coupled example initially.
candidates.proposed_verification: Compare visible water and buoyancy sample heights with timestamps; stress readback delays and wave changes.

candidates.title: Near-shore water and boat wakes
candidates.observed_mechanism: Dedicated near-shore and wake simulations participate in the ocean surface/query architecture.
candidates.proposed_boundary: A small shoreline plus one boat with the original GPU pass scheduling.
candidates.proposed_verification: Compare shoreline/wake interactions at fixed path/time, including grid recentering and GPU resource lifetime.

candidates.title: Cinematic camera director with user handoff
candidates.observed_mechanism: Director coordinates authored spots and title/blow/follow/inside/drift/pop states with manual gaze, FOV, focus and film/fade values.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Bubble target plus a camera/director state machine, keeping manual-input handoff explicit.
candidates.proposed_verification: Replay blow→follow→inside→pop, interrupt with drag, and verify smooth framing and no stuck input.

candidates.title: Shared wind field and bubble flight
candidates.observed_mechanism: Wind exposes gust and curl fields; Flight combines terrain slopes, gorge flow, thermals and obstacle-aware motion. Visual vegetation and moving bubbles share wind concepts.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Wind query with explicit clock/seed, plus flight adapter injecting terrain and obstacles; extract gorge assumptions into data.
candidates.proposed_verification: Sample CPU/GPU wind at matching points/time; replay bubble paths near slopes, trees and rising thermals.

candidates.title: Thin-film bubble rendering
candidates.observed_mechanism: FILM_GLSL and filmD compute reflection/thickness; BubbleRenderer uses instance data, 3D film noise and depth/environment inputs.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One bubble material and instanced list adapter, retaining sorting and depth dependencies.
candidates.proposed_verification: Compare front/back reflection at fixed age and light; test intersecting bubbles and foreground depth at original DPR.

candidates.title: Simulation/render separation for ambient wildlife
candidates.observed_mechanism: Bird behavior and species rendering live in separate simulation and render modules.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One ambient species producing pose/state snapshots into an instanced or pooled renderer.
candidates.proposed_verification: Freeze/replay simulation snapshots and compare visible poses; measure update/render cost separately.

candidates.title: Action combat, input windows and hit sweeps
candidates.observed_mechanism: Combat combines buffered actions, parry/charge/combo policies, swept attack trails and root motion; Actor resolves health/poise and hit outcomes.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One weapon/enemy fixture exposing input, pose samples, sweep queries and combat events.
candidates.proposed_verification: Replay combo/charge/parry/dodge windows at fixed step; ensure a sweep hits once and preserves stagger/knockback.

candidates.title: Combat lock-on and obstruction recovery
candidates.observed_mechanism: Camera uses lock candidates, trunk obstruction queries, pivot clamps and recovery/handoff logic with FOV and shake.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Target pose plus candidate/obstruction services; separate shot policy from world geometry.
candidates.proposed_verification: Circle a target near trees, switch lock and enter boss framing; check near-plane clipping and recovery continuity.

candidates.title: Versioned procedural resource cache
candidates.observed_mechanism: Small IndexedDB helper versions keys, clears older prefixes and fails softly when cache access is unavailable.
candidates.proposed_boundary: A cache adapter returning optional results; keep generated resource format/version in the caller.
candidates.proposed_verification: Test empty/warm/old-version/denied storage and late worker completion; gameplay must still initialize.

candidates.title: Ordered simulation/render stages
candidates.observed_mechanism: Named numeric stage order places input/player/combat/enemies before camera/effects/audio/UI and final render.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Explicit phase registration with deterministic order and lifecycle ownership.
candidates.proposed_verification: Trace stage ordering, pause/resume and disposal; reject duplicate/unregistered handlers in a future adapter.

candidates.title: Track-relative kart simulation
candidates.observed_mechanism: Track helpers provide projection/loop/rail/support queries; stepDriver manages drift, boost, airborne/tricks, rescue and progress/checkpoints.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Track query plus driver state/input step; preserve track format and vehicle tuning.
candidates.proposed_verification: Replay drift release, ramp/trick landing, off-track rescue and gate crossing; compare state traces with original client.

candidates.title: Racing and battle AI
candidates.observed_mechanism: botInput, curveAt and pack/rival pacing share the race state; battle has separate shot and rotation handling.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Bot input policy using the same driver controls; keep race and battle policies separate.
candidates.proposed_verification: Seed a full race and a battle; track progress, recovery loops, item use and terminal results.

candidates.title: Spatial race audio and bounded voices
candidates.observed_mechanism: Audio loads dynamic cue/music paths, handles unlock/rebuild/pause, limits simultaneous one-shots and spatially mixes nearby rival engines.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Audio event sink with asset resolver and listener/rival poses.
candidates.proposed_verification: Pause/resume and switch course repeatedly; compare cue timing, rival panning and bounded voice counts with no missing assets.

candidates.title: Kart LODs, crowds and course assets
candidates.observed_mechanism: Hashed GLBs load through an import map; course rendering combines LOD/shadow models, instanced spectators, procedural props and dynamic sky/ground textures.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One course renderer with explicit dynamic asset manifest, preserving original shader/LOD choices.
candidates.proposed_verification: Visit all eight courses, compare LOD silhouettes/shadows and collect every runtime request at original DPR.

candidates.title: Snapshot interpolation and server boundary
candidates.observed_mechanism: Client connects to /kart-room, handles resume/session/frame messages and retains bounded frame history; server authority and ranked state are not deployed client code.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Protocol/interpolation study only until the real server source is available.
candidates.proposed_verification: Document message shapes from code; future authorized server tests need jitter/loss/reconnect. Do not use mock success as parity evidence.

candidates.title: Airship movement, orbit and input ownership
candidates.observed_mechanism: Renderer-independent Simulation integrates pitched/strafe/altitude flight. FlightCamera uses unwrapped drag angles, exponential follow and explicit shortest-arc recentering.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Simulation input/state plus camera/view adapter; preserve original metre scale and max pitch.
candidates.proposed_verification: Use existing flight/input/camera tests and actual W/boost/drag/recenter in exploration mode.

candidates.title: Creature feeding, capture and persistence
candidates.observed_mechanism: Creature states include roam/flock/forage/flee/capturing; feeding/capture/coin/respawn events drive rewards and saves with validated reconstruction.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Deterministic ecosystem state plus event sink and injected storage, independent of scene rendering.
candidates.proposed_verification: Existing ecosystem/save tests plus capture cancellation, delayed respawn and reload with pending coins.

candidates.title: Layered clouds, materials and pooled effects
candidates.observed_mechanism: Atmosphere, material detail/deformation and SkyEffects are separated from simulation; original visuals combine cloud layers and bounded particles.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One sky/ship/material fixture with a separately owned effects pool.
candidates.proposed_verification: Compare fixed flight poses at native DPR; inspect cloud overdraw and effect-pool memory across repeated capture/boost.

candidates.title: Reproducible Blender asset pipeline
candidates.observed_mechanism: Modeling scripts batch meshes by material and animation pivot; original editable Blender scene and runtime GLBs are retained.
candidates.proposed_boundary: One creature plus near/far garden export with provenance, units, pivot and material contracts.
candidates.proposed_verification: Regenerate into a separate output, compare bounds/pivots/material slots and runtime silhouette; never overwrite hand-edited originals.

candidates.title: Threejs-Punk · Engine audio
candidates.observed_mechanism: Unchanged sampled and procedural V8 AudioWorklets with original audio banks in a standalone RPM, throttle and gear host. Includes limiter cuts, turbo release on lift and an automatic six-gear sweep.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Host-authored acceleration/coasting fixture, not full vehicle physics. Original parameter protocol, smoothing, engine EQ/gain and Quadra constants are retained. Turbo plays original takes with a host envelope; full procedural flutter/body/whistle/echo, positional acoustics, nitro, tires and other game layers are omitted. Related nitro/tire source assets are pinned but unused. Worklets expose no layer weights. Browser checks prove signal/parameter changes, not subjective full-game audio parity. No blanket upstream reuse license is claimed.
dependencies: Browser ES modules and Web Audio AudioWorklet (localhost or HTTPS)
Original engineSampler and engineSynth worklets, V8 recording and pitch map, turbo release bank
User gesture to start audio; no Three.js, build step or external requests
candidates.proposed_verification: node --test examples/punk-engine-audio/*.test.mjs && python3 examples/punk-engine-audio/test_browser.py

candidates.title: Tupi · Forest impostors
candidates.observed_mechanism: Unchanged original forest builder plus a labelled 120-tree comparison grove using original species helpers, scanned meshes and flora atlases. Cards/full meshes, host-controlled automatic LOD, draw distance and renderer counts. Unchanged environment module supplies the sun, sky environment and mist; calibrated host diffuse fill keeps the isolated canopy legible.
candidates.proposed_boundary: The original forest has fixed path-distance bands and no runtime full-mesh toggle. That selector and the 180-unit camera-distance LOD apply only to the comparison grove. Original forest view disables the selector. Optional species-model streaming is skipped with nospecies; original scans, atlases and procedural special species remain. Uses built-in terrain-height fallback and flat ground. Original environment starts at the forest chapter (104 seconds), with host diffuse fill instead of film automatic exposure; not pixel-identical full-film lighting.
dependencies: WebGPU-capable browser on localhost or HTTPS
Original Three.js core, WebGPU and TSL chunks plus OrbitControls
Byte-identical archived Tupi module closure and required assets
Plain browser ES modules; no build or external network
candidates.proposed_verification: node --test examples/tupi-forest-impostors/*.test.mjs && python3 examples/tupi-forest-impostors/test_browser.py

candidates.title: Tupi · Paddling fleet
candidates.observed_mechanism: Original fleet, paddling and canoe modules with archived crew models and baked shapes. Time scaling, 1/3/6/12 canoes, camera presets and orbit controls.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Stroke speed scales the entire original animation clock, including movement and wakes. Count changes reload and reset time. Original small crew phase offsets remain. Uses the fleet module standalone water fallback, host ambient fill and lighter water material; no full river or film environment. Original v4 rig may warn about a 2.2 cm hand-to-paddle gap.
dependencies: WebGPU-capable browser on localhost or HTTPS
Original Three.js core, WebGPU and TSL chunks plus OrbitControls
Byte-identical archived Tupi module closure and required assets
Plain browser ES modules; no build or external network
candidates.proposed_verification: node --test examples/tupi-paddling-fleet/*.test.mjs && python3 examples/tupi-paddling-fleet/test_browser.py

candidates.title: Tupi · Rain river
candidates.observed_mechanism: Original Tupi water and atmosphere modules running unchanged with rain intensity, mist, light-phase controls and an orbit camera.
candidates.proposed_boundary: Host bank silhouettes supply scale and reflection contrast. No original terrain, forest, fleet, audio or post-processing. The distant cinematic rain curtain is hidden; nearby rain, ripples, sky and fog use the original shaders.
dependencies: WebGPU-capable browser on localhost or HTTPS
Original Three.js core, WebGPU and TSL chunks plus OrbitControls
Byte-identical archived Tupi module closure and required assets
Plain browser ES modules; no build or external network
candidates.proposed_verification: node --test examples/tupi-rain-river/*.test.mjs && python3 examples/tupi-rain-river/test_browser.py
